changeSet.sql: UPDATE generator SET localtargetq = targetq, localtargetv = equivalentlocaltargetv; UPDATE battery SET localtargetq = targetq; UPDATE vscconverterstation SET localtargetq = reactivepowersetpoint, localtargetv = voltagesetpoint; UPDATE staticvarcompensator SET localtargetq = reactivepowersetpoint, localtargetv = voltagesetpoint; UPDATE shuntcompensator SET localtargetv = targetv; UPDATE regulatingpoint rp SET targetvalue = CASE WHEN rp.regulationmode = 'VOLTAGE' THEN (SELECT g.targetv FROM generator g WHERE g.networkuuid = rp.networkuuid AND g.variantnum = rp.variantnum AND g.id = rp.regulatingequipmentid) WHEN rp.regulationmode = 'REACTIVE_POWER' THEN (SELECT g.targetq FROM generator g WHERE g.networkuuid = rp.networkuuid AND g.variantnum = rp.variantnum AND g.id = rp.regulatingequipmentid) ELSE NULL END WHERE rp.regulatingequipmenttype = 'GENERATOR'; UPDATE regulatingpoint rp SET targetvalue = (SELECT b.targetq FROM battery b WHERE b.networkuuid = rp.networkuuid AND b.variantnum = rp.variantnum AND b.id = rp.regulatingequipmentid) WHERE rp.regulatingequipmenttype = 'BATTERY' AND rp.regulationmode = 'REACTIVE_POWER'; UPDATE regulatingpoint rp SET targetvalue = CASE WHEN rp.regulationmode = 'VOLTAGE' THEN (SELECT s.targetv FROM shuntcompensator s WHERE s.networkuuid = rp.networkuuid AND s.variantnum = rp.variantnum AND s.id = rp.regulatingequipmentid) ELSE NULL END, targetdeadband = (SELECT s.targetdeadband FROM shuntcompensator s WHERE s.networkuuid = rp.networkuuid AND s.variantnum = rp.variantnum AND s.id = rp.regulatingequipmentid) WHERE rp.regulatingequipmenttype = 'SHUNT_COMPENSATOR'; UPDATE regulatingpoint rp SET targetvalue = CASE WHEN rp.regulationmode = 'VOLTAGE' THEN (SELECT v.voltagesetpoint FROM vscconverterstation v WHERE v.networkuuid = rp.networkuuid AND v.variantnum = rp.variantnum AND v.id = rp.regulatingequipmentid) WHEN rp.regulationmode = 'REACTIVE_POWER' THEN (SELECT v.reactivepowersetpoint FROM vscconverterstation v WHERE v.networkuuid = rp.networkuuid AND v.variantnum = rp.variantnum AND v.id = rp.regulatingequipmentid) ELSE NULL END WHERE rp.regulatingequipmenttype = 'VSC_CONVERTER_STATION'; UPDATE regulatingpoint rp SET targetvalue = CASE WHEN rp.regulationmode = 'VOLTAGE' THEN (SELECT s.voltagesetpoint FROM staticvarcompensator s WHERE s.networkuuid = rp.networkuuid AND s.variantnum = rp.variantnum AND s.id = rp.regulatingequipmentid) WHEN rp.regulationmode = 'REACTIVE_POWER' THEN (SELECT s.reactivepowersetpoint FROM staticvarcompensator s WHERE s.networkuuid = rp.networkuuid AND s.variantnum = rp.variantnum AND s.id = rp.regulatingequipmentid) ELSE NULL END WHERE rp.regulatingequipmenttype = 'STATIC_VAR_COMPENSATOR';
